title: Asteroid 2024 YR4
excerpt: When discovered, asteroid 2024 YR4 appeared to have a small chance of impacting Earth on Dec. 22, 2032. Experts now think it poses no significant risk to Earth.
content:
New NASA Asteroid Observations Eliminate Chance of 2032 Lunar Impact

Asteroid 2024 YR4 is a near-Earth asteroid.

Using data from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope observations collected on Feb. 18 and 26, experts from NASA’s Center for Near-Earth Object Studies have ruled out any chance of 2024 YR4 impacting the Moon on Dec. 22, 2032.

Webb Finds Asteroid 2024 YR4 is Building-Sized

Webb telescope imaged the asteroid in infrared light.
